title: Ptium v1.69.19
reason: Assets only; no version bump, commit or tag was made. The kubectl schema check in build-offline.sh needs a reachable cluster and this host has none (connection refused on both the --dry-run=client and the --validate=false fallback), so the build was re-run with kubectl out of PATH, which is the script's own documented no-kubectl path; the manifest was validated offline instead and decodes into 4 resources (ConfigMap, Deployment, Service, Ingress). All other checks ran and passed, including the first-run and upgrade end-to-end checks against the built image.
